data.name: Sarah
data.gender_notes: Sarah is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Sarah, 'princess, noblewoman' (Genesis 17:15). Its root is Hebrew ś-r-h. Sarah, wife of Abraham (Genesis 17:15). Sarah is a Hebrew name meaning “Princess; noblewoman”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sarah expresses “Princess; noblewoman”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sarah total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
